title: Hover, selected, focus and disabled layers on a highlighted row

steps.do: Move the mouse over the highlighted Work row
steps.expected: The hover layer shows over the row and the highlight FFFB8F is still visible under it
steps.why: Row 8 (task row, menu says Work Breakdown) highlighted FFFB8F. While hovered, Description cell has an extra layer rgba(24,144,255,0.14) over background-color rgb(255,251,143) (FFFB8F kept, not replaced). Mixed colour has no exact value: a person judges the picture.

steps.do: Click the row to select it
steps.expected: The selected look shows and the highlight is still visible
steps.why: Row selected (double-click No. cell, class b-selected): every cell keeps background-color rgb(255,251,143) with layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) on top. A single click selects one cell only (layer 0.14/0.08), it does not select the row. Mixed colour: a person judges the picture.

steps.do: Click a cell of the row so it has focus
steps.expected: The focus look shows and the highlight is still visible
steps.why: Clicked Description cell: it gets b-focused, background-color stays rgb(255,251,143); no colour layer and no outline/box-shadow was measured for focus (outline none), so the focus look is not measurable. A person must look at the picture.

steps.do: Click an empty area of the page
steps.expected: The row looks like FFFB8F again
steps.why: Clicked an empty area above the grid: background-color of all cells = rgb(255,251,143), but the row stays selected (layer rgba(24,144,255,0.08) still on cells 3-8) and the focus stays; clicking outside does not clear the selection. Not exactly FFFB8F: a person decides.

steps.do: Record how the disabled cell of the Platform row looks with no highlight
steps.expected: The look is written down for comparison
steps.why: Platform row FP (row 1), read-only Duration cell (class b-readonly-cell): background-color rgb(242,248,250) with layer rgb(245,245,245), text colour rgb(89,89,89); recorded for comparison.

steps.do: Right-click the Platform row, open Highlight Row and choose B9E0FF
steps.why: Row FP selected, Highlight Row, B9E0FF: background-color of cells = rgb(185,224,255) (= B9E0FF), class shutdown-cell--highlight on cells.

steps.expected: The disabled look is still visible, mixed with the highlight, and the cell is still recognised as disabled
steps.why: Duration cell keeps class b-readonly-cell, layer rgb(245,245,245) and text rgb(89,89,89) over background-color rgb(185,224,255) (row also selected, layer 0.08). Mixed colour, no exact value: a person judges the picture.

steps.do: Right-click the Platform row, Highlight Row, No Color, then reload without Save
steps.expected: The disabled cell looks as in step 5
steps.why: After No Color and a reload without Save: 0 highlighted cells on the page; Duration cell bg rgb(242,248,250), layer rgb(245,245,245), text rgb(89,89,89) = same as step 5. Picture taken after the reload. Row 8 also back to white rgb(255,255,255).
